text_block_list.text: One day, I catch Hishi Amazon in the hallway, groaning with her head in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Dang it, how can a simple headache get the best of me, the great Hishiama—arrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh… Hey, Teach. Don't you worry, it's not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I probably used my brain way too much and gave myself a headache…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nah, I was reading a recipe book. It's the one my dad used back in the States.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But the units in the book are completely different to Japan's! Apparently, one pound is about 453 grams!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And all the temperatures were written in Fahrenheit. I can't do number stuff very well…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: But the pictures looked so good! It took me a while to calculate things, but I found a way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Urk… Talking makes the pain worse!
Hishi Amazon is struggling to deal with her headache.
